headline: MBBS-Trained Physician | Clinical Evidence, Medical Education and Stakeholder Engagement
summary: MBBS-trained physician with emergency, ICU and occupational health practice and four years in health technology at Greenway Health. I translate clinical evidence for varied audiences: I reviewed clinical literature for evidence-based EHR content, presented to clinicians at Greenway's provider conference and to client leadership, and trained 200+ providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants. On the Patient Safety Committee I triaged safety issues through release, and at Outlier I build rubrics that test frontier AI for clinical accuracy. I'm looking to bring that scientific rigour and clinician-facing communication into medical affairs.
greenway_bullets: Reviewed clinical literature on the Clinical Content Team to keep EHR clinical content evidence-based and aligned with guidelines.
Presented clinical and product concepts to provider audiences at the Greenway Engage conference and directly to client clinical leadership.
Designed and delivered training for 200+ clinicians and staff, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants.
Patient Safety Committee member: triaged patient safety issues and defects from detection through stage-gate release, working with product, engineering and leadership.
Built trusted relationships with client practices, close to 200 of them, as their main clinical contact, translating clinician needs into product decisions.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and partnered cross-functionally before engineering handoff.
skills: clinical literature review, evidence synthesis, presentations to clinicians and leadership, clinician education and training
stakeholder relationships, patient safety review, working with product, engineering and leadership, ethical and compliant conduct
emergency medicine, critical care, occupational health, clinical AI evaluation and rubric design
